basis: Classical horary per Lilly, 4th/7th-house purchase rules: the Sun, significator of the seller, is in the 7th and received by Venus in exaltation near the cusp of the 7th, showing a seller well-disposed and open to agreement; the lord of the 7th is also lord of the 11th, the querent's hopes. Venus applies by trine to Saturn, lord of the 4th (the houses themselves), perfecting the bargain for the property; Saturn, lord of the 4th, has no material debility except retrogradation and cadency, so the houses/deal are sound though slow. The Moon translates light by square out of signs of long ascension, mitigating the square and carrying the matter to conclusion with labour. Mercury, lord of the querent's 2nd, retrograde explains the money delay in the setting, but the perfecting Venus-Saturn trine and the 7th=11th link show money procured in time rather than the purchase failing.
prediction_text: Yes — he shall purchase Master B.'s houses. He will deal successfully with the seller, the seller will be pliable and abate something from the first demand of £530, and he will procure the money in time to pay, though not without delay and effort; the seller's forbearance/terms help bridge the wait for his own money.
timing: In months, not days: completion is delayed (Mercury, lord of his 2nd, retrograde — his own money cannot be called in for six months) but is brought about within that order of time, once the money becomes available/the seller allows respite.
